mapper.select: select warehouse_id, write_mode, read_mode, reconcile_status, last_reconcile_time, last_reconcile_batch, approved_by, approved_time from inv_warehouse_stock_mode where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}

select a.allocation_id, a.shipment_id, a.shipment_detail_id, a.transfer_id, a.transfer_detail_id, sd.item_type, sd.item_id, sd.product_id, sd.item_code, sd.item_name, td.unit, a.allocation_policy, a.tracking_policy, a.allocated_quantity, a.balance_version_after, a.cost_price, a.total_cost, lot.warehouse_id as source_warehouse_id, a.balance_id as source_balance_id, a.lot_id as source_lot_id, a.location_id as source_location_id, lot.lot_no as source_lot_no, lot.supplier_batch_no, lot.production_date, lot.expiry_date, lot.qc_status, lot.lot_status, lot.receipt_disposition as source_receipt_disposition, loc.location_code as source_location_code, loc.location_type as source_location_type, sd.shipped_quantity as shipment_detail_shipped_quantity, sd.received_quantity as shipment_detail_received_quantity, td.quantity as transfer_detail_requested_quantity, td.delivered_quantity as transfer_detail_delivered_quantity, td.received_quantity as transfer_detail_received_quantity, a.accepted_received_quantity, a.damaged_received_quantity, a.shortage_reported_quantity, a.receipt_version from inv_transfer_shipment_allocation a inner join inv_transfer_shipment_detail sd on sd.shipment_detail_id = a.shipment_detail_id and sd.shipment_id = a.shipment_id and sd.transfer_id = a.transfer_id and sd.transfer_detail_id = a.transfer_detail_id inner join inv_transfer_detail td on td.detail_id = a.transfer_detail_id and td.transfer_id = a.transfer_id inner join inv_inventory_lot lot on lot.lot_id = a.lot_id and lot.item_type = sd.item_type and lot.item_id = sd.item_id inner join inv_warehouse_location loc on loc.location_id = a.location_id and loc.warehouse_id = lot.warehouse_id where a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} order by a.allocation_id

select audit.shipment_serial_id, audit.allocation_id, audit.shipment_id, audit.serial_id, audit.serial_no_snapshot, serial_current.serial_no as current_serial_no, audit.item_type, audit.item_id, audit.source_balance_id, audit.source_lot_id, audit.source_location_id, audit.status_after, serial_current.warehouse_id as current_warehouse_id, serial_current.balance_id as current_balance_id, serial_current.lot_id as current_lot_id, serial_current.location_id as current_location_id, serial_current.serial_status as current_status from inv_transfer_shipment_serial audit left join inv_inventory_serial serial_current on serial_current.serial_id = audit.serial_id and serial_current.item_type = audit.item_type and serial_current.item_id = audit.item_id left join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_serial receipt_serial on receipt_serial.shipment_id = audit.shipment_id and receipt_serial.shipment_serial_id = audit.shipment_serial_id where audit.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} and receipt_serial.receipt_serial_id is null order by audit.allocation_id, audit.serial_id

select location_id, warehouse_id, location_code, location_name, location_type, sort_order, status, is_virtual from inv_warehouse_location where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and status = '0' and is_virtual = '0' and location_type in ('storage', 'quarantine') order by case when location_type = 'quarantine' then 1 else 0 end, sort_order, location_id
